command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
# spawn's task shell drops the image PATH; R needs a writable TMPDIR and HOME.
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
: > smoke-check.txt; : > qc.tsv; : > peaks.mtx
echo "Rscript: $(command -v Rscript)  arch: $(uname -m)"

echo "== the staged fixture and signac.R must match their pins =="
printf '8f7c8d49cc21a9d9df4e3a7f58b74a2852fa5dff44335d4099e8869c8880430e  fragments.tsv.gz\n488ac54d6dad6b6114815d2f947e0047362cec55ce6a07dc69af385b64887553  fragments.tsv.gz.tbi\n223798646021dce6b1333346142190f993afc27d71817166be718906a8df5549  peaks.bed\n878b9a0ff3ce8556dee57bf290272e7567f440670db98e931078fcb4e9a0da56  genes.tsv\n83921e7bb394b00967379d61edd68a4647672709ee784a347c5a2db9235a0c44  truth.tsv\n3e8ae15c18e677d49437823afe945abe14cbe24c6af6726f60b9fdb20c202cb4  signac.R\n' > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: the staged fixture does not match its pins"; exit 1; }

T0=$(date +%s)
Rscript signac.R > smoke-check.txt 2>&1; RC=$?
T1=$(date +%s)
cat smoke-check.txt
echo "signac.R rc $RC in $((T1-T0))s"
test "$RC" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: a Signac check failed"; exit 1; }
grep -q "^SIGNAC OK" smoke-check.txt || { echo "FAIL: signac.R did not reach completion"; exit 1; }
test -s qc.tsv && test -s peaks.mtx || { echo "FAIL: outputs are empty"; exit 1; }
echo "DONE"
